answer: Bind every identity to one active mobile line. Each epoch the network picks a random ledge of seats and requires a carrier-signed challenge proving the SIM's IMSI still holds a billed subscription; the nullifier ledger rejects reused lines. An attacker farming a karst of burner phones pays real monthly fees per head, and recycled numbers collide—so cheap keypairs whisper nothing while phone-bill scarcity caps the swarm.
